title: Predict
text: Predict responses using a trained deep learning neural network, 1 input, 1 output, {Input data formats} sets Input data format of dlnetwork character vector; {Network}, {File path} sets the mAT file containing trained network, {MATLAB function}, {Mini-batch size} sets the size of mini-batches, {Predictions} sets the output predicted scores or responses and {Activations} sets the output network activations for a specific layer layers. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: input
ports.summary: Image, feature, sequence, or time series data numeric array

ports.name: output
ports.summary: Predicted scores, responses, or activations numeric array

params.name: Network
params.values: Source for trained network Network from MAT file (default) | Network from MATLAB function

params.name: File path
params.values: MAT file containing trained network untitled.mat (default) | MAT file path or name

params.name: MATLAB function
params.values: MATLAB function name squeezenet (default) | MATLAB function name

params.name: Predictions
params.values: Output predicted scores or responses on (default) | off

params.name: Input data formats
params.values: Input data format of dlnetwork character vector | string

params.name: Activations
params.values: Output network activations for a specific layer layers of the network
